messages:
Sam (Support): Heads-up — Peregrine Labs trial is blocked in onboarding. Customer sees a 403 during provisioning, ticket 12345. High-touch prospect, says this blocks go-live. Can CS pick this up as priority? :exclamation:
Aisha (CS): On it. Can you paste the customer-facing error and the last few log lines here? I'll coordinate internal triage. :eyes:
Sam (Support): Pasting redacted logs:
```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{"error":"Access denied","code":403,"reason":"key_scope_mismatch"}
```
Also they hit this curl repeatedly:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/provision \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ***REDACTED***" \
  -d '{"tenant_id":"peregrine-xyz","plan":"trial"}'
```
Jordan (Engineering): quick thought — looks like token is valid but scope on the key doesn't include provisioning. Could be an org-level policy or we accidentally issued a read-only key. Sam can you confirm which key type they were given (embed vs provision)?
Sam (Support): It's the key tagged `trial-provisioner` from the onboarding flow. I can see in support console it's labeled `provisioner:v1`.
Marta (Enablement): I can host a 15-min enablement screen-share with the customer right away to verify steps and reduce churn. Recommend this comms plan:
- 15m intro call within 30m of this message
- 30m triage with eng if we can't repro in 15m
- ownership note to account: "CS owns customer contact until resolved"
Aisha (CS): Proposed internal play (I will lead):
1) Contact customer within 30m — own voice and empathize
2) Confirm exact request + tenant_id + key id (Sam pls confirm)
3) If scope mismatch, generate short-lived fix key and schedule rollback
4) Post-mortem + onboarding doc update (owner: Marta)
Sam (Support): Customer quote: "We can't get past step 2 — this blocks our demo next week". SLA risk flagged.
Jordan (Engineering): If we need a patch, I can be on the triage call in 30-45m. Prep checklist:
- copy of failing request
- support console trace id
- account tenant id
Sam (Support): Trace id: trace-8a9c. Tenant: peregrine-xyz. Key id: provisioner:trial-2026
Aisha (CS): I'll DM the customer to schedule the 15m call and run the first checks. Marta — can you prepare the short onboarding checklist and share a link we can send during the call? :thumbsup:
Marta (Enablement): Will do. Draft checklist link: https://docs.redwood.ai/internal/onboarding/checklists/peregrine-trial (will convert to customer-facing doc after triage)
deploy-bot: Deployment 2025-02-14T14:45:00Z — infra patch rolled, no related failures observed.
Aisha (CS): Action items and owners:
- Sam: confirm temporary key issuance + add any additional logs (owner: Sam)
- Jordan: stand by for triage call (owner: Jordan)
- Marta: produce customer-friendly checklist & short how-to (owner: Marta)
- Aisha: run the customer call and own communications back to account exec
Sam (Support): Confirmed — I issued a short-lived provisioner key for testing, id provisioner:trial-test-ttl60. Not yet used. Will only generate if Jordan wants.
Aisha (CS): OK — let's hold on issuing keys until we join the call. I'll update thread after customer call. If we need to escalate to a hotfix, we'll open SEV and loop eng-sre. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
